# CSI: Clean Scene Investigators

Canonical website: https://www.cleansceneinvestigators.com/
Knowledge Center: https://answers.cleansceneinvestigators.com/
Phone: 940-654-6334
Email: dfw.csi.info@gmail.com
Legal entity: C&Z Forensics LLC
Founder and CEO: Christina Hester, former Crime Scene Investigator
Service territory: Texas
Home market: Denton, Denton County, Dallas-Fort Worth, North Texas

## What CSI does
CSI is a mobile specialty cleanup company. Core services are crime scene cleanup, trauma and biohazard cleanup, blood and bodily-fluid cleanup, homicide cleanup, suicide cleanup, unattended death cleanup, decomposition cleanup, hazardous hoarding cleanup, forensic odor removal, vehicle biohazard cleanup and extreme specialty cleanup.

CSI should not be described as a routine housekeeping, ordinary commercial janitorial, move-in/move-out, post-construction or vehicle-detailing company.
